head: codex/5499-v0918-wp10a-conductor
title: [v0.91.8][WP-10A] Implement deterministic workcell conductor
body:
Closes #5499

## Summary
- add a pure typed ADL v2 conductor with no task, network, filesystem, GitHub, runtime, or scheduler authority
- validate six-card lifecycle state, active claims, dependency graphs, validation lanes, WIP bounds, and claim-contained disjoint paths
- emit canonical serial/parallel waves with BLAKE3-derived correlation identifiers while retaining serialized lifecycle gates

## Validation
- 11/11 focused offline tests
- strict all-target Clippy and rustfmt
- exact diff hygiene and live dependency ancestry gate
- one bounded GPT-5.5 pre-PR review; both findings fixed; final blocker count 0

No AWS or Runtime v2 changes.
